SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id);

SELECT a.region_id AS Id, a.region_name AS label, a.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "region" AS infoType FROM t_std_region a LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON a.up_region_id = b.region_id UNION ALL ( SELECT d.camera_id AS Id, d.camera_name AS label, d.up_region_id AS upId, b.region_name AS upName, "camera" AS infoType FROM t_camera_info d LEFT JOIN t_std_region b ON d.up_region_id = b.region_id) UNION ALL ( select e.preset_id as Id, e.preset_name as label, f.camera_id as upId, f.camera_name as upName, "preset" as infoType from t_camera_preset e left join t_camera_info f on f.camera_id = e.camera_id);

SELECT a.camera_id, a.camera_name, a.url FROM ( ( ( t_camera_info a LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset b ON a.camera_id = b.camera_id ) LEFT JOIN ( t_cruise_point_instance c LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete d ON c.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id ) ON b.preset_id = c.cruise_id ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_plan e ON c.instance_id = e.instance_id ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task f ON e.plan_id = f.plan_id WHERE task_id = #{taskId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
